name: egm
description: Develop ideas with context and review documents with fresh eyes.

interface.longDescription: Develop an idea, improve a plan, or review a document with independent AI reviewers. Reviewers start without the earlier conversation to help spot missing context, unclear reasoning, and hidden assumptions. Use it to challenge proposals and project plans. For software work, draft design documents, document a codebase, and check whether code matches a design. You decide which changes to make. Reviews require a local executor and isolated subagents.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this idea into a clear plan.
Review this proposal for gaps and unclear assumptions.
Review this software design before we build it.
